# ScalPOS

> ScalPOS is an offline-first point of sale for Ghanaian shops, built for phones,
> tablets and counter desktops. It runs the register, inventory, customer credit
> ledger, staff roles and reports on the device — syncing to the cloud only when
> signal returns. Payments are recorded against a built-in ledger (Cash, MTN
> MoMo, Telecel Cash, Card, split tenders, customer credit), and yearly cloud
> plans are billed through Paystack.

## Product

- **Offline-first register** — barcode scanning, cart discounts, split tenders
  and Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal receipts, all working without a connection.
- **Inventory** — per-SKU stock with a movement log (Purchase, Sale, Damage,
  Return, Count, Opening) and low-stock alerts.
- **Customer credit** — attach part-paid sales to a customer, track the running
  balance owed, and record repayments.
- **Staff roles** — Owner, Supervisor and Cashier permissions on the same shop.
- **Reports** — sales, payment mix, staff activity and stock on the same day the
  counter closes.
- **Cloud plans** — yearly Paystack billing with a 7-day free trial, no card
  needed to start.

## Pricing

- **Standard — GHS 120/year (GHS 10/month).** Single-owner shop: full offline
  register and cart discounts, cloud backup and restore, Paystack checkout
  (MoMo or Card), manual yearly renewal.
- **Enterprise — GHS 360/year (GHS 30/month).** Everything in Standard, plus
  Owner/Supervisor/Cashier roles, real-time multi-device sync, conflict
  resolution, remote owner sale and low-stock alerts, desktop and multi-counter
  access.
